news.text: Traders report a buyers’ market and no buyers
news.body: Everyone is waiting for next month, when it will all be cheaper again. It is a rational calculation and it is strangling the trade.

news.text: Children are leaving school for the fields
news.body: Attendance falls away as soon as a household needs the hands or the wage. Inspectors record it and no one acts on the record.
What a household has left to spend, after tax and after prices, is less than it was. Settlements agreed in good faith last year look thin now.

news.text: Plant standing idle across the trade
news.body: Machines that cost a fortune are turning over for a single shift or not at all. Managers describe the position as temporary and have done for some time.

news.text: Out of work and out of the figures
news.body: Relief offices describe applicants who have stopped registering because registering achieved nothing. The official count sees none of them.
